text:
sara-chen: follow-up from today's all-hands runtime segment. two asks: 1) kernel v5 canary timeline and gates; 2) short-term mitigations for the kv-cache eviction spikes impacting some low-latency pools. collecting replies here for a customer note.

jason-roberts: plan: if remaining perf tests pass, tiny canary in us-west-2 tomorrow morning (single pool). expand to cross-region small canary 48h later. gating: no sustained eviction >0.06 for 10m, p99 delta <8%, zero OOMs. will post canary id when started.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: kernel-v5 | canary-id=kv5-1725 | region=us-west-2 | status=queued.

anita-garcia: root-cause signal shows bursts of long-prefix prompts bypassing prefix cache and causing KV reshuffle. short ops mitigations: increase per-pool reserve_fraction and enable prefix_fold_window to reduce churn. low-risk and reversible.

trevor-moss: batching note: dynamic microbatching helps tail SLOs. recommendation for affected low-latency pools: dynamic_microbatch=true and target_batch_size=24-32 (start at 32). we'll ship an auto-tuner next sprint.

maya-singh: eviction/seq_len heatmap dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime/eviction-heatmap (runtime leads). DM me for access.

anita-garcia: ops config snippet we rolled to test: 
```yaml
pool_overrides:
  - pool_name: low-latency-1
    reserve_fraction: "0.35"
    dynamic_microbatch: "true"
    target_batch_size: "32"
    prefix_fold_window_secs: "3600"
```
jason-roberts: kernel heuristic tweak: bias allocator to smaller initial KV allocations when seq_len variance is high. included in v5. rollback: toggle predictor flag to legacy. PR and canary job link incoming.

deploy-bot: Canary started: canary-id=kv5-1725 in us-west-2 | status=running.

sara-chen: thanks all. jason/anita/trevor please post PRs/runbook with explicit rollback steps and watchdog metrics by EOD Friday. i'll draft the customer-facing follow-up after review and schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow to review canary telemetry. :calendar:
